## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde walk to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school together while discussing their schoolmates and their beautiful surroundings. During afternoon classes, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by calling her 'Carrots' and pulling her hair, prompting an enraged [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to smash her slate over his head.
>

> In class, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her red hair, prompting her to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md) punishes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by forcing her to stand at the front of the room and later making her sit beside Hugh, leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to declare that she will never return to school. Upon returning home, [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) seeks advice from [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), who recommends letting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rest at home until her temper subsides.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh attend a farewell gathering hosted by the B.V.I.S., where they receive send-off gifts. After feeling discouraged by local opinions about her upcoming college attendance, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) goes for a walk through the woods with Hugh, finding a wild apple tree and enjoying a quiet walk home along [Linger Lane](../codex/places.md#linger-lane).
>
> — v3 · Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

> In the attic at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Isolde Duckett](../character/isolde-duckett.md) chat about Nell's upcoming marriage to [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) and her move to [Seven Gulls Harbor](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-harbor). They reflect on their past, Isolde's young daughter [Small Nell Lucinda](../character/small-nell-lucinda.md), and the local gossips of [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley).
